desc:
⚖️ YOU'VE BEEN ARRESTED... BUT ARE YOU REALLY GUILTY?

You have 3 DAYS until your trial.

🚔 Get arrested and survive detention  
🔎 Find evidence that could save your case  
🗣️ Watch what you say during interrogations  
👨‍⚖️ Build your defense with your lawyer  
🏀 Explore the prison and uncover secrets  
⚖️ Face the judge, witnesses, and jury  
🎁 Earn Justice Stars and unlock permanent Case Items  
🏆 Discover multiple different endings!

Every decision can come back during your trial.

Will you prove your innocence... or make everything worse?

badges.name: Not Guilty
badges.desc: The jury has spoken. You're officially innocent... this time.

badges.name: Guilty
badges.desc: Well, that didn't go as planned. The jury found you guilty!

badges.name: Case Dismissed
badges.desc: Case closed! You managed to get the charges thrown out.

badges.name: Wrong Person
badges.desc: They arrested the wrong person. That's a little embarrassing.

badges.name: House Arrest
badges.desc: You're going home! Unfortunately, you're not allowed to leave.

badges.name: Community Service
badges.desc: No prison for you! Just a whole lot of community service.

badges.name: The Informant
badges.desc: You know something they don't. Time to make a deal.

badges.name: Framed
badges.desc: You were set up! Uncover the truth and expose the real story.

badges.name: Secret Agent
badges.desc: From prisoner to secret agent. Your new mission is classified.

badges.name: The Mastermind
badges.desc: You weren't just part of the story. You were behind it all.

badges.name: Corrupt Judge
badges.desc: Justice is blind... but apparently not immune to money.

badges.name: Contempt of Court
badges.desc: Congratulations! You managed to make the judge lose their patience.

badges.name: Lawyer of the Year
badges.desc: An absolutely legendary defense. Even your lawyer is impressed!

badges.name: Jury Loves You
badges.desc: Forget the evidence. The jury absolutely loves you!
